skills.name: Raining Tiger Blade
lines: Fire type piercing attack on a single enemy x2 (XL) and Fire type slash attack x2 (XL)
* Increase number of piercing hits when used consecutively (2nd use: 3 hits, 3rd+ use: 4 hits)
* 50% per hit outside Another Force
* In Another Force, add 40% of Combo to total multiplier of each part (Piercing, Slash)
** Combo used for multiplier calculation is the Combo from the beginning of skill execution
** Piercing per-hit multiplier (Max of 150% per hit, at 500%+/750%+/1000%+ Combo)
*** 50% + [40% of Combo]÷2, rounded down
*** 50% + [40% of Combo]÷3, rounded down
*** 50% + [40% of Combo]÷4, rounded down
** Slash per-hit multiplier (Max of 150% per hit, at 500%+ Combo)
*** 50% + [40% of Combo]÷2, rounded down
* Can activate Resonant Raid skills:
** Raining Tiger Claw
** Raining Tiger Fire

abilities.name: Concerto Gauge
lines: Concerto Gauge: At turn-end, the Concerto Gauge will fill up with the number of hits landed on enemies by party (Max stack: x30).

* When Concerto Gauge is full, if Skills used by characters with Concerto Artes fulfill certain requirements within that turn, the Concerto Gauge will be emptied to activate Concerto Arte: Resonant Raid.
